Which export document comes when? 📦

1️⃣ Quotation: you price the goods and state the terms
2️⃣ Purchase order: the buyer orders
3️⃣ Proforma invoice: you confirm the order
4️⃣ Commercial invoice + packing list: for customs
5️⃣ Delivery note on delivery, then a receipt when paid

All of them can be made at paperwork.315tools.com and saved as PDF, Word or Excel.
